seoTitle: Google Autocomplete Keyword Scraper: Suggestions API
seoDescription: Scrape Google Autocomplete suggestions for any seed keyword by country and language. A-Z, question, preposition expansions. Pay per keyword; failures free.

keyword-queried.eventDescription: One seed keyword fully processed, including every enabled expansion (a-z, questions, prepositions, numbers) and depth-2 re-queries. All suggestions found for that keyword are included in the price. Keywords that fail because of network errors or rate limiting are not charged.
